llm.summary: This skill is a scoped Chinese K12 teacher assistant for drafting stage reports and renewal talking points from one student's learning records, with clear consent checks and no automatic sending or broad data changes.

dimensions.detail: It handles sensitive minor education records, but that access is disclosed and proportionate to generating longitudinal progress reports; the artifact limits output to aliases and excludes real names, contacts, family, medical, financial, and unsupported psychological labels.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown and JSON reference material with no executable files, package install steps, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions repeatedly require a named student alias before reading data, prohibit cross-student scanning, require source-backed claims, and block parent-visible output unless consent fields allow it.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to confirmed progressEvidence entries written by this skill; it explicitly does not modify student cards, course ledgers, authorization settings, communication logs, status fields, or full student deletion workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the capabilities: it reads lesson logs, homework followups, course package data, parent communication summaries, consent fields, and progress evidence to draft report text and renewal suggestions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for a Chinese-language K12 teacher workflow where the workspace consent fields are maintained. Teachers should verify the named student, review all generated parent-facing text before sending, and avoid using it as a general multilingual or non-China-localized reporting tool without localization.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only templates and schema values are consistent with the artifact's explicit scope as a Chinese Mainland Simplified Chinese K12 workflow; shared platform conventions also warn that other regions/languages require localization before deployment.
